summary: Gix Internet Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 3, 2026, announcing that Quantum X Labs Inc. (Nasdaq: QXL) demonstrated its Qatacomb quantum encryption scheme on an IBM Quantum Heron r2 processor. Gix holds approximately 13% (2,818,585 shares) of QXL as a strategic minority stake. No transaction, price, premium or board recommendation is stated; this is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer current report on a technology milestone, not a special situation. Watch only for any future monetization or stake-related action.
